theme_archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with PASTEL & SOFT
instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign every screen using the design system below. Do NOT change functionality.
Use React Native primitives (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, FlatList).
DO NOT use Skia, SVG gradients, or text gradients.
Apply Apple Health spacing (generous padding) and Notion Calendar crisp typography.
Apply Finch-like cozy pastels sparingly for mood chips and cards.
Use expo-blur for sticky headers and tab bars ONLY.

glassmorphism_tokens.rules: Use ONLY for sticky top bars and tab bar backgrounds.
glassmorphism_tokens.implementation: import { BlurView } from 'expo-blur'; <BlurView intensity={50} tint='light' style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} />

screen_by_screen_notes.Onboarding: Full-screen layout. Hero image at top (max-h 40vh). H1 crisp serif for welcoming text. Bottom fixed container with generous padding and PrimaryButton ('Get Started').
screen_by_screen_notes.Auth: Clean Notion-style layout. Left-aligned input labels. 8px radius on inputs with subtle borders. SecondaryButton to toggle Login/Signup.
screen_by_screen_notes.Mood_CheckIn: Use a grid or wrapped flex layout for the 7 pastel mood chips (PillTags scaled up). 'How are you feeling?' in H2 serif. Optional note input uses 16px radius with secondary background.
screen_by_screen_notes.Home_Dashboard: Apple Health vibe. Top greeting left-aligned in serif H1. Use MetricCard for mood recap. 'Talk to Lumi' CTA wrapped in a pastel green ContentCard. AI tasks listed as a sleek vertical list with custom circular checkmarks.
screen_by_screen_notes.Lumi_Chat: Tab bar MUST use glassmorphism. Animated SVG character centered in upper space, surrounded by generous negative space. Chat bubbles: 24px radius, pastel green for user, white for Lumi. Bottom container holds a massive IconButton for the voice mic, and a minimal voice/type toggle.
screen_by_screen_notes.Events: Sticky header MUST use glassmorphism. Below header, horizontal ChipRow for categories. Vertical FlatList of ContentCards for events with 16px gap.
screen_by_screen_notes.Profile: Clean user header. 2-column grid of MetricCards for stats. NEW Weekly Recap section: ContentCard with H2 numbers, AI reflection body text, and SecondaryButton for sharing. NEW Task Streaks: FlatList of tasks where each item includes a StreakBadge on the right. Recent moods as simple list rows.

responsive_rules.small_devices_le_360: Reduce h1 to 32px, h2 to 24px. Reduce base padding from 24px to 16px. Reduce gap between MetricCards.
responsive_rules.large_devices_ge_390: Use full 36px for h1. Keep layout padding at 24px. Ensure bottom CTA buttons don't stretch too wide (max-width 400).

image_urls.description: Stacked pastel pink abstract discs - use for onboarding visual or empty states.
Minimal green leaf plant - use as a botanical placeholder fitting the Lumi vibe.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a testID attribute (e.g., testID='login-button') to facilitate robust automated testing in React Native.
Optical alignment over geometrical alignment. Ensure icons with text are vertically centered.
Avoid solid black; use tinted dark tones for text.
Never use transparent backgrounds under headers/tab bars where content scrolls; always use expo-blur.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts. Use left alignment for readable text and metrics.
Create depth through generous padding, layered cards, and subtle shadow elevations.
Never use generic placeholder characters like 🤖. Follow the Lumi aesthetic.
Always apply modern button styles (pill-shaped) with active opacity feedback (TouchableOpacity).
Avoid AI slop. Keep UI intentional, calming, and highly functional like Apple Health and Notion.
